newsitem.title: LATVIA: Controversial Latvian finance minister quits.
newsitem.headline: Controversial Latvian finance minister quits.

text.p: Latvia's new finance minister, at the centre of a row between Prime Minister Andris Shkele and President Guntis Ulmanis that caused the premier to resign, has quit his post.
A spokesman for Shkele said that Finance Minister Vassily Melnik asked to be removed and that Shkele agreed to the request.
The spokesman said he could not say why Melnik had decided to go.
Shkele on Monday said he was resigning after Ulmanis called on parliament not to back Melnik, who was proposed as finance minister by Shkele and a leading government party.
Ulmanis made the call after a newspaper reported that Melnik was being investigated by the prosecutor's office for a conflict of interest under anti-corruption laws.
The prosecutor's office confirmed the report but said it found no wrongdoing.
